description: Inverter, either flipping the sign of a voltage or turning a gate into its opposite

params.text: In the CV position 1.7V or more gives 0V out and anything lower gives 1.7V out, the reverse of the maker's manual; in the V/OCT position the sign of the input is flipped, so 3.4V in gives -3.4V out

notes: With nothing patched into IN the missing input is read as 0V, so in the CV position OUT is held at a steady 1.7V.
